metadata.description: A small Claude Code starter kit: hooks that stop unverified completion claims and ask before anything is sent out, plus a few everyday skills.

plugins.name: claim-guard
plugins.description: Blocks the end of a turn when the AI claims 'verified' or 'not found' without having run a check or a search, or when it edited files after the last check.

plugins.name: block-outgoing-comms
plugins.description: Asks you to confirm before any tool sends an email, chat message or post, so nothing goes out unseen.

plugins.name: agentcrew
plugins.description: Four everyday skills: polite (tone rewriting), humanizer (removes AI-sounding patterns), explain (plain-language re-explain), first-principles (decision decomposition).

plugins.name: agentcrew-closure
plugins.description: checkpoint (one-step session close) with neat-freak (its fact-reconciliation engine). Assumes you keep a daily log and your notes or projects in git; if you don't, skip this one.

plugins.name: write-manifest
plugins.description: Silently records which files each session edited, so checkpoint stages only this session's changes when several sessions share a repo.

plugins.name: no-emoji-guard
plugins.description: Blocks file writes that contain emoji and tells the AI what to use instead.
